summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing the issuance of US$1.5 billion 6.750% Perpetual Subordinated Contingent Convertible Securities, which were issued on 18 May 2026 under an effective shelf registration statement on Form F-3. This is a routine capital markets transaction by the issuer, not a special situation like a tender offer, going-private, or restructuring. The securities are complex instruments with high risk, admitted to trading on Euronext Dublin. No special-situation catalyst is involved; the filing simply confirms satisfaction of conditions precedent and issuance of the securities.
